role: Manual release workflow ("Deploy TestFlight"): gates on the full ci.yml via workflow_call, then signs, archives, exports and uploads the iOS app (with embedded watch app) to TestFlight.
state: secrets: APPSTORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID, APPSTORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID, APPSTORE_CONNECT_PRIVATE_KEY, IOS_DIST_P12_BASE64, IOS_DIST_P12_PASSWORD, APPLE_TEAM_ID
toplevel: Trigger: workflow_dispatch only. Both jobs require repository_owner chrissharp80. deploy requires quality-gate result success explicitly. Build number = run_number.run_attempt. No concurrency group of its own; the called ci.yml's group (ci-Deploy TestFlight-<ref>, cancel-in-progress) means a second dispatch on the same ref cancels the first's quality gate, which then skips the first deploy.

units.does: Reusable-workflow job: calls ./.github/workflows/ci.yml (workflow_call, scope defaults to full) so lint/budgets, strict concurrency, TSan, release build and the full test suite with coverage floors must pass before deploy.
units.entry: GitHub Actions job in testflight.yml; workflow_dispatch only.

branches.effect: runs on the owner's repo; on a fork it is skipped, and deploy then does not run

units.does: macOS-26 job (timeout 60) that archives, exports and uploads the app to TestFlight; needs quality-gate.
units.entry: GitHub Actions job in testflight.yml, after quality-gate.
calls: .github/workflows/testflight.yml::step deploy/Write App Store Connect API key

branches.effect: deploy runs; any other quality-gate result (failure, cancelled, skipped) skips deploy

units.does: Writes a "Release evidence" markdown table to $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY: commit sha, xcodebuild version, swift version, iphoneos SDK version, first 16 hex of SHA-256 of Package.resolved.
units.entry: Step of testflight.yml deploy job (runs only after quality-gate succeeded on a chrissharp80-owned repo)

units.does: Checks six secrets (APPSTORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID, _KEY_ID, _PRIVATE_KEY, IOS_DIST_P12_BASE64, IOS_DIST_P12_PASSWORD, APPLE_TEAM_ID) are non-empty; lists missing ones and exits 1.
units.entry: Step of testflight.yml deploy job (runs only after quality-gate succeeded on a chrissharp80-owned repo)

branches.cond: a secret env var is empty

branches.effect: print names to stderr and exit 1 (deploy fails); else continue

units.does: Decodes the base64 .p12 into $RUNNER_TEMP/dist.p12, creates an empty-password temporary keychain (6 h lock timeout), unlocks it, imports the p12 with -A (all apps may use the key), sets the key partition list for apple-tool/apple/codesign, and puts the build keychain plus login.keychain-db in the user search list.
units.entry: Step of testflight.yml deploy job (runs only after quality-gate succeeded on a chrissharp80-owned repo)

units.key: step deploy/Write App Store Connect API key
units.does: Writes the App Store Connect private key secret to ~/.appstoreconnect/private_keys/AuthKey_<KEY_ID>.p8.
units.entry: Step of testflight.yml deploy job (runs only after quality-gate succeeded on a chrissharp80-owned repo)

units.does: xcodebuild archive of scheme Emuqu, Release, generic iOS, into $RUNNER_TEMP/Emuqu.xcarchive with DEVELOPMENT_TEAM from secret, CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION=<run_number>.<run_attempt> (applies to app and watch app), -allowProvisioningUpdates authenticated by the ASC API key. MARKETING_VERSION unchanged.
units.entry: Step of testflight.yml deploy job (runs only after quality-gate succeeded on a chrissharp80-owned repo)

units.does: Writes ExportOptions.plist (method app-store-connect, automatic signing, strip Swift symbols, teamID, uploadSymbols) and runs xcodebuild -exportArchive into $RUNNER_TEMP/export with ASC-key provisioning.
units.entry: Step of testflight.yml deploy job (runs only after quality-gate succeeded on a chrissharp80-owned repo)

units.does: Finds the first *.ipa in $RUNNER_TEMP/export; if none, prints an error and exits 1; otherwise uploads it with `xcrun altool --upload-app --type ios` using the ASC key id/issuer.
units.entry: Step of testflight.yml deploy job (runs only after quality-gate succeeded on a chrissharp80-owned repo)

branches.effect: print "No IPA found" and exit 1; else upload
